full_page.content:
1931, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 8
Dec. 16 Brain-hemora: Mary Amelia Collinson - 13 mo. - In August -whooping Cough - pneumonia - plurisy - 6 days in oxigen and now brain hemor- ages Doctors sent her home hopeless in Nov. Really improving.
Dec. 18 Mrs. Catherine Tintore - 29 - bone tumor threatened with bone-cancer. Dr. fears whole arm should be amputated - Enrolled To-day .... Jos. A. Ouellette - 53 - Brights disease - Blind - Worrying Mrs. Agnes Henry - 65 - double cateracts - 8 children - 1 in convent
Dec. 29 Mrs. Walker reported by phone last night as dangerously ill came this evening with Jewish neighbor who did the said phoning ... OK. To-night
Page 9
Dec. 20 Poisoned Kidneys-Pertinitis: 6 P.M. Harold Liefin, a lutheran - 22- has poisoned kidnies - hopeless - dying now two weeks - is enrolled in S. Mass As'n at 7 P.M. reported no better. Fr. S. visits and blesses boy advising parents to promise sacrifice of something pleas- ing to God -e.g. to investigate true religion
Dec. 21 James Terry - 38 - away from home through drink. Wife asks prayers and enrolls him in S.M. Assoc'n
Donald Bownass - 22 - not talking - can not sit up or stand - not baptized - parents Episcopelians ....
Boils - girl 14 - Rita Schutza - troubled much with boils - Jan. 9, 1932 Now O.K. going back to school
Dec. 23 Catherine Kiss - 23 - one yr in bed T.B. threatened with loss of six ribs and lung. Preparations for operation being made for early in January.
Page 10 Dec. 23 Mrs. Brisson - 36 - of Bay City - Rhumatism
Sylvia Parker - 9 - of Bay City Michigan - now 3 yrs. paralysed; laments that she is only one of 8 brothers and sisters not able to play .... Father became Cath when married but after 3 yrs. fell away. ..... was here a year ago.
Donald Bruwier 1 puzzle to Drs. - Parents have lost three little ones in 4 yrs.
